compiled_state.title: Document aws-status.sh JSON schema in plugins/dso/docs/telemetry/aws-status-schema.md
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN (doc-only artifact — no executable behavior)

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2: The JSON schema of aws-status.sh output is stable and documented so downstream health-check scripts can consume it without parsing drift.

## What to create

Create `plugins/dso/docs/telemetry/aws-status-schema.md` documenting the stable JSON shape emitted by aws-status.sh:

- `schema_version` (integer, current value: 1) — top-level field; downstream scripts MUST check this and refuse unknown versions.
- `bucket` — {present (bool), name (str), lifecycle_tier ("Glacier-IR"), public_access_block_enabled (bool), sse_enabled (bool)}. When present=false: only {present: false}.
- `lambda` — {present (bool), name (str), function_url (str), reserved_concurrency (int|null)}.
- `iam_role` — {present (bool), name (str), trust_policy_includes_lambda (bool)}.
- `log_group` — {present (bool), name (str), retention_days (int)}.
- `metrics` — always emitted as {last_24h_event_count: int}; value is 0 when log group is absent. NOT a present-bool object — metrics is always a counts object.

Breaking changes to field names, types, or absent-resource semantics MUST bump schema_version.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Schema doc exists at correct path (docs/telemetry/, NOT scripts/telemetry/)
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/telemetry/aws-status-schema.md
- [ ] Schema doc declares schema_version 1
  Verify: grep -E 'schema_version.*1' plugins/dso/docs/telemetry/aws-status-schema.md
- [ ] Schema doc names all five resource sections
  Verify: for k in bucket lambda iam_role log_group metrics; do grep -q "$k" plugins/dso/docs/telemetry/aws-status-schema.md || { echo "missing $k"; exit 1; }; done

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body:
AC amendment (gap analysis): Schema doc must enumerate per-resource attribute fields explicitly, not just section headings. Required fields per resource:
- bucket: present (bool), name (str), lifecycle_tier (str, expected 'Glacier-IR'), public_access_block_enabled (bool), sse_enabled (bool). When present=false: {present: false} only.
- lambda: present (bool), name (str), function_url (str|null), reserved_concurrency (int|null). When present=false: {present: false} only.
- iam_role: present (bool), name (str), trust_policy_includes_lambda (bool). When present=false: {present: false} only.
- log_group: present (bool), name (str), retention_days (int). When present=false: {present: false} only.
- metrics: last_24h_event_count (int) — always emitted as a counts object, never a presence flag.

The schema doc must document these field names and types verbatim. Downstream tasks 98f7 and 55ab test against these exact field names.
